title: AI for Older Adults
content: An AI designed to assist older adults with digital tasks. The creator believes this concept is a few generations ahead, suggesting it may not be immediately practical. Despite this, the AI is considered worth exploring further.
raw_text: Can make an ai for older people who will act as a helper for their digital tasks. But i don't think it will sustain for long. It's few generation thing. But still worth to look into
